Fidèle à ses principes et à son engageme: True to its principles and societal commitment, Ooredoo, in collaboration with the Algerian Literacy Association "IQRAA", organized a commemorative ceremony honoring the late Mrs. Aïcha Barki, founder and former president of the association, on the occasion of the seventh anniversary of her passing.
Femme de principes et l’une des figures: A woman of principle and one of the most prominent figures in the fight against illiteracy in Algeria, the late Aïcha Barki embodied a symbol of the struggle for knowledge, women's empowerment, and the anchoring of the values of dignity and hope. Through her human and activist journey, she has left an indelible mark on Algerian society.
Des représentants de Ooredoo et de l’ass: Representatives of Ooredoo and the "IQRAA" association, led by Mr. Ramdane Djezairi, Director of Corporate Affairs, Press Relations & CSR at Ooredoo, and Mr. Hocine Khelid, President of the "IQRAA" association, took part in this commemorative ceremony held at Ooredoo's headquarters, in the presence of members of the deceased's family, her peers, partners from the associative movement, as well as several civil society representatives.
La cérémonie a débuté par une présentati: The ceremony began with a presentation retracing the activist journey of the deceased as well as her contributions to literacy and the promotion of education. On this occasion, Mr. Ramdane Djezairi praised the exceptional journey of the deceased, while highlighting the strength of the strategic partnership uniting Ooredoo and the "IQRAA" association for some twenty years, in the service of literacy, education, social inclusion, and women's empowerment. A presentation of several projects carried out with Ooredoo since 2006 was screened, including the creation of six (06) Literacy, Training, and Insertion Centers for Women and Girls (AFIF) and the launch of the "Ooredoo Literacy Prize" in 2013, aimed at rewarding individuals, institutions, organizations, and associations, whether public or private, for their remarkable contributions to supporting efforts to eradicate illiteracy in Algeria.
Parmi les principales réalisations concr: Among the main achievements realized within the framework of this partnership are the AFIF educational center in the municipality of El Khroub in the wilaya of Constantine in 2009, the Temacine center in Ouargla inaugurated in April 2013, the Ouled Yahia Khadrouche center in Jijel in November 2015, the Tizi Ouzou center in September 2016, followed by the Aïn Bessem center in Bouira in February 2018, as well as the Béchar center inaugurated in January 2023.
La cérémonie a également été marquée par: The ceremony was also marked by moving testimonies from family members and friends of the deceased, as well as founding members of the "IQRAA" association and civil society representatives, who recalled the human qualities of Mrs. Aïcha Barki, her legacy, and the profound and lasting impact she left within Algerian society.
L’évènement s’est poursuivi par un homma: The event continued with a tribute paid by Ooredoo to members of the "IQRAA" association as well as to the family of the deceased through the presentation of an honorary trophy, in recognition of their contributions and continuous efforts to perpetuate the message of Mrs. Aïcha Barki in favor of knowledge and the fight against the scourge of illiteracy.
À travers cet hommage, Ooredoo réaffirme: Through this tribute, Ooredoo reaffirms its loyalty to the values upheld by the late Aïcha Barki and renews its commitment to supporting national initiatives aimed at combating illiteracy and promoting knowledge and education, convinced that these constitute the essential foundations upon which societies are built.
